intro.quote: This document defines a new BGP NLRI, called the MCAST-VPN NLRI.

fields.name: Route Type
fields.explain: Identifies the encoding used for the route-type-specific portion of the NLRI.

cite.quote: The Route Type field defines the encoding of the rest of MCAST-VPN NLRI (Route Type specific MCAST-VPN NLRI).

fields.name: Length
fields.explain: Gives the length in octets of the route-type-specific field.

cite.quote: The Length field indicates the length in octets of the Route Type specific field of the MCAST-VPN NLRI.

fields.name: Route Type specific
fields.explain: Carries the variable-length route encoding selected by the Route Type field.

cite.quote: The RD is encoded as described in [RFC4364].

fields.name: Source AS
fields.explain: Carries the source autonomous system number.

cite.quote: The Source AS contains an ASN. Two-octet ASNs are encoded in the low-order two octets of the Source AS field.

fields.name: Multicast Source Length
fields.explain: Gives the length of the multicast source address in bits.

cite.quote: If the Multicast Source field contains an IPv4 address, then the value of the Multicast Source Length field is 32. If the Multicast Source field contains an IPv6 address, then the value of the Multicast Source Length field is 128.

fields.name: Multicast Source
fields.explain: Carries the C-RP address for a shared-tree join or the C-S address for a source-tree join.

cite.quote: For a Shared Tree Join route, the Multicast Source field contains the C-RP address; for a Source Tree Join route, the Multicast Source field contains the C-S address.

fields.name: Multicast Group Length
fields.explain: Gives the length of the multicast group value in bits.

cite.quote: If the Multicast Group field contains an IPv4 address, then the value of the Multicast Group Length field is 32. If the Multicast Group field contains an IPv6 address, then the value of the Multicast Group Length field is 128.

fields.name: Multicast Group
fields.explain: Carries the C-G address or a C-MP opaque value.

cite.quote: The Multicast Group field contains the C-G address or C-MP Opaque Value Element.

intro.quote: This document defines and uses a new BGP attribute called the "P-Multicast Service Interface Tunnel (PMSI Tunnel) attribute".

fields.name: Tunnel Type
fields.explain: Identifies the tunneling technology and determines the syntax and meaning of the Tunnel Identifier.

cite.quote: The Tunnel Type identifies the type of the tunneling technology used to establish the PMSI tunnel. The type determines the syntax and semantics of the Tunnel Identifier field.

fields.name: MPLS Label
fields.explain: Carries an MPLS label in its high-order 20 bits; zero indicates the absence of a label.

cite.quote: If the MPLS Label field is non-zero, then it contains an MPLS label encoded as 3 octets, where the high-order 20 bits contain the label value. Absence of an MPLS Label is indicated by setting the MPLS Label field to zero.

fields.name: Tunnel Identifier
fields.explain: Carries a tunnel identifier whose syntax depends on the selected Tunnel Type.

cite.quote: The Tunnel Type identifies the type of the tunneling technology used to establish the PMSI tunnel. The type determines the syntax and semantics of the Tunnel Identifier field.
